name: Garden Grove Recreation Leader Jobs (Atlantis Play Center and Sports)
org: City of Garden Grove Community Services Department
what_you_do: Work part time at the Atlantis Play Center or the Sports and Recreation Center. You may help run the snack bar and splash pad. You may help with events. You may also referee and keep score at youth games.
who_can_apply: For the Atlantis Play Center and Sports jobs, you must be at least 16 years old by May 20, 2026. Day camp and resource center jobs on the same page are for ages 18 and up, by May 20, 2026.
pay_detail: Recreation Leader pay is $17.00 to $19.00 an hour. Recreation Specialist pay is $18.50 to $20.50 an hour.
duration: Part time. Hours vary with the program.
deadline_text: The page lists 2026 age cutoff dates. It gives no closing date. Use the Apply link to see which jobs are open now.
how_to_apply: Use the Apply Now link on the city page to apply on the city job site.
notes: Lifeguard and Instructor Guard jobs are on the same page. The page does not state a minimum age for them. Atlantis Play Center and Sports jobs are year round. Paid work for people under 18 in California needs a Permit to Employ and Work.
